summary: Selects one of Stability's named visual presets on compatible direct edit and control endpoints. Lixpi deliberately omits it because the current Bedrock route invokes Ultra or SD3.5 foundation model IDs, whose request schemas do not accept this field; the Bedrock Image Services that do accept it use separate model IDs Lixpi does not invoke.
combines: The direct control and edit surfaces publish 17 preset values, but the value is not portable to Lixpi's current Bedrock foundation-model transport.
Exposing it would let a saved per-model configuration work on one transport and silently disappear or fail on another.
Users can describe the desired style in the prompt without creating transport-dependent saved state.
note: Deliberately unused because it is not portable across the two live Stability transports.
